notes.title: SANABI Official Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Greetings from Wonder Potion. 

It’s already been a year and a half since we excitedly released the Early Access last June 22nd. 

We were able to create an improved game thanks to the beta tests and the invaluable feedback from the community. 

We want to take a moment to express our heartfelt gratitude – thank you. 

With the support from all of you, we are now ready for the official release. 
In this official release version, players can enjoy all chapters and endings. 
For those who played the Early Access version – your progress will be transferred, allowing you to continue your adventure from the subsequent chapters. 


Patch Notes: 

1. New Chapter Addition & Existing Chapter Enhancements
- Added content up to the ending after Chapter 3
- Added scenes for the Chapter 2 boss (Justice)
- Significant improvements to the story and stages in Chapter 3
- Other sub-events and existing events have been improved


2. Addition of Multiple Endings
- 2 additional endings that players can unlock depending on their choices


3. Improvement in Controls
- Improved responsiveness of controls, including adjustments in Chain Arm delay and range
- Enhanced aiming correction mechanism for Chain Arm


4. Improvement in Level Design
- Fixed stages that were excessively long or difficult
- Improved terrain structures that were inconvenient for players using controllers


5. Sound Enhancements
- Added a lot of missing SFX and BGM 


6. Addition of achievements and Steam collectibles


7. Bug Fixes
- Bugs and issues reported up to this point have been fixed

※ The speedrun mode will be polished and updated shortly after the official release. 
We are also excited to announce the release of two free DLCs, exploring the past of the protagonist and Mari. These DLCs are planned to be released in the first half of 2024, so please look forward to it!

If you come across any issues or have suggestions, please don’t hesitate to inform us via Steam Community or our official Discord channel. We assure you that your concerns will be promptly addressed.  

One again, we express our deepest appreciation for your unwavering love and support. 

Best regards,
Wonder Potion.

notes.title: SANABI Official Release & Final Test
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Wonder Potion, the developers of SANABI. 

It’s been a while since our last update!

Since our last roadmap announcement 3 months ago, we have been fully dedicated to the final stages of SANABI’s development. We would like to share an update on the development progress, especially regarding the official release schedule. 

First and foremost, we would like to give our sincerest apology for being unable to fulfill our promise regarding the official release date. There has been a delay in our development due to build optimization, preparing for a Nintendo release, going through certification processes, and other crucial final tasks. As a result, the official release of SANABI has been postponed until early November. We apologize for disappointing our dedicated fans who have been eagerly awaiting the official release of SANABI. We truly appreciate your love and support for our game, and we are deeply sorry to let you down. 

In an effort to fulfill at least a part of our promise to our players, we have decided to share the Final Beta version of SANABI for those who have purchased the Early Access. The Final Beta version will include a significant portion of the story and boss battles, enabling players to experience one of the two endings from the full game. The Beta version is scheduled to be available on Steam on August 8th. 

A year ago, we released the Early Access version of SANABI, and it has received overwhelming love from the players. And today, we are sincerely grateful and sorry to share this news. The best way to compensate and repay our fans is to deliver an exceptional gaming experience. We will continue to work diligently to ensure that SANABI becomes a game that remains in your hearts for a long time. 

Thank you for your understanding and unwavering support. 

With warmest regards,
Wonder Potion.

notes.notes:

Changes Made

Chapter 3

1. Laser Bot and Laser Shooter

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/3405578ad03d212df14afc503598172866559bd4.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/22e85712b4036368c2656384e4fe0eaf0a29108d.png
 - We received much feedback regarding the previous laser damage. Instadeath was an unfair mechanic and increased the game's difficulty more than our expectations
 - Instadeath from all lasers has been removed and now will inflict 1 amount of damage to the player


2. Switch

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/d5445484e378c4667eae4ed1053d3580022e2a81.png
 - More detailed appearances and varieties of switches have been added. We anticipate this will be more intuitive for which switches are used to interact with which certain gimmicks in Chapter 3


3. Clones

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/12b0e12237647ee942bfbba68549709f3e354e7f.gif
 - Clones are robots that can be controlled by pressing the interaction key (Default: F)m once the player is close enough
 - Clones can be destroyed even with a single blow but allow the player to enter unreachable areas to activate certain gimmicks


4. Press Switch

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/7955b19ca257f52543f882f6cb22aad795f57782.png
 - A large switch that is activated while a clone or the player is stepping on it


Chapter 4

1. New Ability: Charge Dash

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/2d77c7a5b32c39d79c9674bee647575afd31caf6.gif
 - Can be executed using the same key for Swing Dash(Shift, B key on controllers), after charging a certain amount of time it grants the player the ability to dash toward a nearby object at a high velocity.
 - Able to knock-back some gimmicks in Chapter 4 and allows the player to take down certain enemies that can not be defeated normally.


2. Knockback-able Objects

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/3676802332be3d27add94c868c451321f2567a2e.png
 - Objects that can be knockedbacked by the player's Charge Dash. Utilise your abilities to place objects in the right place and crave your very own path.


3. Armoured Enemies

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/e2ecb88418ff33f5b6121ec8fb48a326f438133d.png
 - Enemies that will appear in Chapter 4 are heavily armed and armoured. Unlike the enemies you have already faced, a frontal assault on these enemies will not work, utilise the terrain and objects to create an opening.


Key Notes

1. This build only contains the playable levels, elements from the story nor events are not included.
2. In total, this build contains 6 scenes.
3. SFX for some content is not included or may sound awkward sometimes.

The Beta version can be accessed through the same method which was previously announced. 
Please follow the details below..

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/bf7527d90853cc15d545853632a98446cfb3701c.gif

New Features

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/b366070894ee3f4c8d22dc17b3d1ba99be35f432.png

 Enabled after reaching Chapter 4, uses the same buttons for Swing Dash (Shift, B on controllers)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/8257a9cac0e2f0c48ee74452c7b14c4c66a1046a.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/e82d38223d8c3c16ce7b67f1d048f5d78624141d.png

notes.title: Early Access Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We are so excited to tell you that SANABI is finally launching for Early Access! This is a huge step for us and we can’t wait to hear your thoughts on our game.

SANABI is planning to have early access until this year, and during this period we will be working on a deeply engaging story, new contents, bug fixes, and balancing based on your feedback.

Hearing your voices through the last beta test was a great opportunity for us to look back at SANABI and make it a user-friendly game. We took it to our heart and tried our best to blend it into the game. 

This early access allows the player to play with not only keyboard/mouse, but with the controller too. Players may also change the difficulty from the settings (Easy/Normal/Hard/Very Hard) and we’ve tweaked the fluidity of the controls, UI, and other systems needed.
But we’re sure there still will be valuable feedback that’ll help us to make SANABI better. Please let us know if you have a great idea to share or found any bugs.

Steam Community : https://store.steampowered.com/app/1562700/_/
Official Discord : https://discord.com/invite/RjzUfMbBGS
Official Support Mail : sanabi_support@neowiz.com

**Recommend you to play with keyboard/mouse. Controller is currently in the process of optimization and we’d appreciate any kind of feedback.

**Let us know your fastest record for the Speedrun mode on Discord!

SANABI will be $14.99 during the early access and is having a 10% discount to celebrate its release. So grab one when you can!

Thanks again for your huge support and please continue the journey with us until the full release. We will do our best to give you the most entertaining experience.

notes.title: Dev Note #2 & Key Changes in Development
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, this is Wonder Potion.

The core game mechanics of SANABI are finished for the most part, so our team is now focusing on adding new content. We're working hard to polish the game so that each chapter is unique in its own way, and we hope our players will notice that as well.

Here's what's coming to SANABI!
(*These are all work in progress, so they are still subject to change throughout development)

Boss Battle: The Writ of Execution


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/f5586cc77273df52022c6fd52eb264a481a93b8f.gif
 An estranged, colossal disintegrator, the “Writ of Execution”
 It’s certainly not an easy task to take down a giant disintegrator. But for some reason, the Writ of Execution’s core is fully exposed...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/757f437584b84fd3c7100d5b4d795a5d6c05584e.gif
 Fortunately for you, there are some cargo drones left around the loading deck! We know Mari is very good at tampering with drones. Perhaps she can help you dismantle the disintegrator?



Game Controls

A. Winding

 Many of you asked if you can reel in the Chain Arm. 
 The ability to wind the Chain Arm was, in fact, already coded in from the start. Introducing this feature too early led to most of the players relying on winding instead of practicing their swinging skills, and we wanted to avoid that. As such, we decided to make winding available in the later stages.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/3ba9fd5ce7de4461129048fa02939f41fd57537f.gif
 Now, you can wind your Chain Arm whenever you want once you unlock the ability. We hope you enjoy the freedom this provides!



B. Chain Arm’s Increased Range

 SANABI requires you to make the most out of its huge maps. We’re sure there were many instances where you felt the Chain Arm was just too short. But if we were to increase the chain’s length, an unnecessarily long range would also be difficult to work with.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/0cb80cff5c0c5653c1e89dc3f8e2f2af9725f3c9.gif
 We’ve changed the mechanics so that the chain shoots long enough, and at the same time, its length will automatically adjust to a reasonable distance. Swing to your heart’s content!



Chapter 2 : Business District, Mago City


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/c0c7c2867f0918f58a17bf159400c62c98f904c0.gif
 Welcome to the Business District of Mago City, the center of capitalism thriving under the protection of imposing authority. A tall skyscraper looming over the city has given the area the alias, Sunless City. No matter! We might not get enough sun, but there are plenty of hologram signs to light the city streets.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/b30284559be1b20a1ad055e1c69c053847222fa4.gif
 Chapter 1 took place in the slums of Mago City. In chapter 2, you’ll be running through Mago City’s Business District. Compared to the rainy and gloomy environment of the slums, the Business District is a vibrant ocean of neon signs. We’ve designed the area to reflect the theme of corrupted capitalism, which is visually represented by sky-high buildings. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/14540d3a1c157d52498a2f4438b2fc830f3c5605.gif
 The Business District is maintained and operated by the local police force. They use their so-called legal authority granted by the city to enforce peace, and will resort to any form of violence to do so.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/d5c9c4e02f5288c0997526a56e99bd1b0ed2cb9d.gif
 Sky Tracks are seen all around the district. They’re meant to be reliable, hi-tech freight transports... but a certain (burly) someone might be able to use them as his own method of transportation.



Title Change

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/17651714da68d6efd408ba3f29ee3e0ef069016c.png

 The English title of the game has officially changed from  to !
 We’ve received feedback from our publisher’s localization expert regarding the spelling and decided to remove the extra N to make SANABI look more appealing to our players in the west.
 The word Sanabi holds a significant meaning in the story, but it’s also one of the first things that determine the impression our game has on you, the players. We’d like to keep the title as simple as possible while maintaining its identity.
 The subtitle "The Revenant" was also removed to maintain unity with the original title in Korean, which will remain as 산나비.



Change in Schedule


 Though our team members put in days and weeks of effort to bring SANABI to you, we’ve realized that we will need to invest more time to create something acceptable in terms of quality.

 We apologize to many players who have been waiting for the official release of SANABI. We know how much love and support we’ve already received from you, and we would like to return the favor with a solid, well-polished game.



2nd Closed Beta date

 November, 2021 → January, 2022

Game release date

 February, 2022 → Q3, 2022


Steam Early Access


 With the way the above dates were pushed back, we now have a large gap between the 2nd Closed Beta and official release.
 Instead of making our players wait an indefinite amount of time, we've decided to release the game as Early Access in Q2 of 2022. The Early Access version of the game will include chapter 3, which accounts for roughly 50~60% of the game's content.
 We'll be sharing details on the second round of Closed Beta and Early Access release with you via our community platforms.


Again, we sincerely apologize for the delay and thank you for your understanding. We appreciate every comment from you guys and it has always been the biggest motivation for us developers.

The weather’s gotten much colder. What a season for staying home and gaming! We’ll bring out another update soon, so please keep an eye on us!

Thank you!
Wonder Potion
